help.faq.journal-private-photos.question: Ngaba ndingazigcina iifoto zam?
help.faq.journal-private-photos.subtitle: Ukulandelela utshintsho olubonakalayo.
help.faq.journal-private-photos.answer: Ewe, kukho iifoto ezifihlakeleyo ezikhuselekileyo, umzekelo, zokulandelela indlela i-acne, ukukhula kweenwele okanye iimpawu zesikhumba ezenzeka ngayo.
help.faq.security-private-data.question: I-AWA iyikhusela njani idatha yam?
help.faq.security-private-data.subtitle: Ubumfihlo, ukhuseleko kunye nokuqokelelwa okuncinane.
help.faq.security-private-data.answer: I-AWA yakhelwe ekuqokeleleni idatha encinci, akukho ntengiso ijoliswe kuyo, akukho kuthengiswa kwakhona kwedatha yobuqu, kunye nokugcinwa okukhuselekileyo kunye nokubethelwa kwangempela kwedatha enobungozi.
help.faq.security-export.question: Ngaba ndingayithumela ngaphandle idatha yam?
help.faq.security-export.subtitle: Ukuthunyelwa kwePDF kunye neCSV kuyaxhaswa.
help.faq.security-export.answer: Ewe. I-PDF yokuthumela ngaphandle kwedatha yakho kunye ne-CSV yokuthumela ngaphandle kwedatha yakho ziyafumaneka, ukuze ukwazi ukwakha imbali ecacileyo, kuquka nomsebenzi wezempilo.
help.faq.security-delete.question: Ngaba ndinokucima idatha yam ngokulula?
help.faq.security-delete.subtitle: Ukucima kuhlala kulula yaye kufikeleleka.
help.faq.security-delete.answer: Ewe. Ukucinywa okulula kwedatha yakho kunye neakhawunti iyafumaneka kwizilungiselelo ezifanelekileyo.
help.guides.getting-started.title: Ukuqala ngeAWA
help.guides.getting-started.text: Fumanisa isikrini sakho sasekhaya, ikhalenda, ijenali, iinjongo nezinto zokomoya.
help.guides.cycle.title: Ukulandelela umjikelo
help.guides.cycle.text: Bhala phantsi ixesha lakho lokuya exesheni, uze uhlolisise izibalo zakho.
help.guides.conceive.title: Ukuzama ukukhulelwa
help.guides.conceive.text: Hlola ukuzala, ukuqhuma kweqanda, ubushushu basal, i-cervical mucus kunye ne-LH.
help.guides.contraception.title: Ukukhulelwa
help.guides.contraception.text: Lawula indlela yakho, izikhumbuzo, iidosi eziphosiweyo kunye nembali yokuthatha.
help.guides.irregular.title: Imijikelo engalunganga / PCOS
help.guides.irregular.text: Qaphela imijikelo engalunganga, i-acne, ukukhula kweenwele, ubunzima kunye neempawu ezinxulumene noko.
help.guides.menopause.title: Perimenopause / Menopause
help.guides.menopause.text: Landelela ukufudumala, ukulala, ukudinwa, imozulu kunye nonyango lwehomoni.
help.guides.pregnancy.title: Ukulandelela ukukhulelwa
help.guides.pregnancy.text: Landelela umhla, iiveki, iintlanganiso, iimviwo neempawu zakho.
help.guides.postpartum.title: Emva kokubeleka
help.guides.postpartum.text: Khangela i-lochia, ukubuya komjikelo, ukuncelisa, ukulala, ukuziva usempilweni nokuvuka.
help.guides.loss.title: Emva kokukhulelwa
help.guides.loss.text: Khangela ukugalelwa kwegazi, iimpawu, nokubuya komjikelo wakho ngesantya sakho.
help.guides.calendar.title: Ukusebenzisa ikhalenda
help.guides.calendar.text: Qonda amaxesha, izibikezelo, izikhombisi, nomboniso weGregorian / Hijri.
help.guides.journal.title: Ukuzalisa idayari yakho yemihla ngemihla
help.guides.journal.text: Ukubhalisa iimpawu, isimo sengqondo, ukulala, umsebenzi, amanqaku kunye nobuhlobo obusondeleyo.
help.guides.spiritual.title: Ukusebenzisa iimpawu zokomoya
help.guides.spiritual.text: Fumanisa ikhalenda yeHijri, ukuhlambuluka, umthandazo, ukuzila ukutya, i-qadaa kunye ne-nifas.
help.guides.privacy.title: Ubumfihlo kunye nedatha
help.guides.privacy.text: Lawula ukhuseleko, imodi ekhuselekileyo, ukuthumela ngaphandle, ukubethela kunye nokususwa kwedatha.
help.helpSupport.title: Uncedo & inkxaso
help.helpSupport.subtitle: Ngaba unemibuzo?
help.helpSupport.supportText: Khetha indlela yokuqhagamshelana nawe ekulungeleyo, okanye khangela iimpendulo eziqhelekileyo.
help.helpSupport.guidesSubtitle: Fumanisa izikhokelo zethu ukuze ufumane okungakumbi kwiAWA.
help.helpSupport.feedbackSubtitle: Yabelana ngeengcamango zakho ukuze usincede siphucule usetyenziso.
help.helpSupport.bannerText: Enkosi ngokuthabatha ixesha lakho ukuze usibhalele.
help.helpSupport.modal.errorEmpty: Chaza isicelo sakho ngaphambi kokuba uqhubeke.

help.faqScreen.intro: Fumana iimpendulo ezibalulekileyo zokusebenzisa iAWA ngoxolo lwengqondo.
